scripts.backend:dev: cd backend && $([ "$(sysctl -n hw.optional.arm64 2>/dev/null)" = 1 ] && echo arch -arm64) .venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload
scripts.backend:models: cd backend && $([ "$(sysctl -n hw.optional.arm64 2>/dev/null)" = 1 ] && echo arch -arm64) .venv/bin/python scripts/download_models.py
scripts.backend:freeze: cd backend && PYINSTALLER_CONFIG_DIR="$PWD/build/pyinstaller" $([ "$(sysctl -n hw.optional.arm64 2>/dev/null)" = 1 ] && echo arch -arm64) "$PWD/.venv/bin/python" -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --onedir --name atlas-backend --paths "$PWD" --distpath "$PWD/dist" --workpath "$PWD/build/pyinstaller/work" --specpath "$PWD/build" --exclude-module matplotlib --exclude-module tkinter --exclude-module pytest --exclude-module IPython scripts/serve.py
scripts.dev:electron: pnpm electron:build && concurrently -k "vite" "pnpm electron:watch" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.pack:dir: pnpm build && pnpm electron:build && pnpm backend:freeze && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm build && pnpm electron:build && pnpm backend:freeze && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --publish never
scripts.pack:win:dir: pnpm build && pnpm electron:build && electron-builder --win --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:win: pnpm build && pnpm electron:build && pnpm backend:freeze && electron-builder --win --publish never
